top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.
